items.description: E2E: navigate to stock table route in deployed app and assert each row has a data-testid='batch-number-cell' element with a visible label and a data-testid='serial-number-cell' element with a visible label, with no element carrying data-testid='inventory-code-cell' anywhere in the table

E2E: navigate to SKU detail route in deployed app and assert the detail panel has a data-testid='batch-number-field' element with its label and a data-testid='serial-number-field' element with its label, with no element carrying data-testid='inventory-code-field' present

E2E: navigate to stock table route in deployed app with a real null-bearing record from the live DB and assert the row's data-testid='batch-number-cell' carries the design-guide empty-state 'not tracked' indicator text and the data-testid='serial-number-cell' carries the 'not tracked' indicator text, with neither cell blank nor showing an error

E2E: navigate to SKU detail route in deployed app with a real null-bearing record from the live DB and assert the detail panel's data-testid='batch-number-field' carries the design-guide empty-state 'not tracked' indicator text and data-testid='serial-number-field' carries the 'not tracked' indicator text, with neither field blank nor showing an error
